news.headline: Record rainfall triggers flooding, landslides in Toyama and Ishikawa
news.body: Record-breaking rain on August 27 caused river flooding and landslides across Toyama and Ishikawa prefectures, forcing evacuations and stranding residents. The Japan Meteorological Agency issued Level 5 emergency warnings and transport services were suspended while rescue teams responded.
